sentences.en: I need money to buy food.
The price of this coat is high.
The cost of the ticket is ten dollars.
This shirt is cheap. That one is expensive.
I buy milk and bread at the shop.
sentences.zh: 我在商店买牛奶和面包。

sentences.en: He sells fruit at the market.
I pay the money at the end.
I keep an account of my money.
Do you have enough money for the book?
sentences.zh: 你有足够的钱买那本书吗？

sentences.en: The value of this old coin is high.
sentences.zh: 这枚旧硬币的价值很高。

sentences.en: I need insurance to keep my house safe.
sentences.zh: 我需要保险来保障我的房子安全。

sentences.en: I have a debt to the bank.
My credit with the shop is good.
sentences.zh: 我在那家店的信用很好。

sentences.en: The exchange rate between our money and theirs is good.
sentences.zh: 我们的钱和他们的钱之间的汇率不错。
